name: wizard-footer
title: Wizard footer
description: The Back, Skip and Continue bar of a multi-step flow: step context, a pending state that locks the other buttons, and the reason in words when Continue is off.
docs: Pass step (counted from 1), stepCount and onContinue. Back shows from step 2 when onBack is given. Skip shows when onSkip is given, so pass it only on optional steps. Continue says Next, or Finish on the last step; continueLabel overrides it. onContinue and onSkip may return a promise: that button shows a spinner and savingLabel while it runs, keeps the keyboard's focus (it is aria-disabled, never disabled) and the others lock; if it throws, the Error's message appears in a row of its own above the bar, as wide as the bar, and the step stays. While canContinue is false and canContinueReason is set, the reason replaces Continue as text in a polite live region. "Step 2 of 5" is a polite live region too, with a segment per step up to 8. sticky pins the bar to the bottom of the area that scrolls. The bar answers to its own width: under 28rem the buttons stack with Continue on top and a long label wraps, then they are a row, and from 36rem the step context joins that row. labels translates.
